pr_body:
Closes #10318

The basis of testing how score portion works is if we hit 3 out of 4 objects while achieving max combo of 2, the portions effected are different enough that the testing is meaningful but still easy to manually calculate. 

Tests for SmallTickHit are probably wrong, but I don't know how they are supposed to act in game modes where they are from (taiko and fruits) because I've not played these. [Wiki](https://github.com/ppy/osu/wiki/Scoring#hit-results) says they affect accuracy so I expected them to get score in Standard scoring but they don't. They don't get score in Classic scoring because we have a combo of 0 in this test.
pr_comments: FWIW I've made slight changes and expanded coverage slightly - think this is good to go but don't want to approve & merge myself entirely as I pushed.
I've reworded the xmldoc a touch. Would appreciate a check if this is readable and grokkable now.

issue_context.title: ScoreProcessor is missing tests for all scoring relationships
issue_context.body:
`ScoreProcessorTest` should ensure that all relationships defined in https://github.com/ppy/osu/wiki/Scoring#hit-results are satisfied - that the correct score portions are affected and the correct `MinResult` is set for each corresponding `MaxResult`.

Additionally, the `HitResultExtensions` methods should also be tested.
comments:
The wiki is wrong actually, pretty sure ``HitCircle`` can't get Perfect judgments.

edit: ~~Meh~~ Good too (it's not in ``OsuHitWindows``)

it'll get fixed soon. scoring is sort of unstable right now, we're addressing that and will update the docs again when that's done. the code is the ground truth anyways, and once the tests come in so will they.

Writing a test for the ``HitResultExtensions`` was basically copy-paste ([commit here if anyone wants to continue making this test](https://github.com/LittleEndu/osu/commit/d87e4c524c1c03539881df35fa97ccf800751aae)) but I can't think of any good way to write a test for relationships outside of just having a beatmap with 4 objects that can be judged the certain type we are testing and intentionally judging the 3rd one with ``MinResult`` so the achieved combo is 2/4
Even just having those tests would be great.

review_comments: How does this test work? Should I be reading the test? Is this test still required? I thought the reason for this test had to do with classic scoring being broken for `maxAchievableCombo = 0`.

This test isn't required anymore but it still works and tests behaviour that's special to small ticks (that they only affect accuracy portion)

Probably needs documentation similar to previous test
